Bug_Title: Return values should not be ignored when they contain the operation status code

Trigger_Explanation: The generated JUNIT test case creates a file and a lock. It then calls the showBug method from the BuggyCode class, which ignores the return values of file.delete() and lock.tryLock(). This causes the assertions in the test case to fail, triggering the bug.
